up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against the human androgen receptor (CHEMBL1871). Output columns: standard_value, ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound key (compound_records.compound_key), PubMed ID or DOI (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay description (assays.description), and target details (target_dictionary.pref_name, target_dictionary.chembl_id). Filter for exact values: activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Restrict target to target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1871'. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs. Return each qualifying activity row.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description, td.pref_name, td.chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1871' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '='
